LotSerial.title: Lot & serial tracking
LotSerial.body: Here you decide per item whether it is tracked by lot, by serial number or not at all, and manage the lots and units that belong to it. Pick an item on the left: the right pane shows its tracking mode and, depending on the mode, its lots with their status and its serial numbers. The mode can only change while no stock is on hand, so the existing movements stay unambiguous.
